svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IfIQuLM91EOqKDeAKXj4"> <mxGraphModel dx="1183" dy="772" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Client
 participant AC as Auth<br/>Controller
 participant AS as Authorisation<br/>ServiceImpl
 participant Cache as Idempotency<br/>Cache (Redis)
 participant AR as Authorisation<br/>Repository
 participant AccR as Account<br/>Repository
 participant FO as Fraud<br/>Orchestrator
 participant FS as fraud-service<br/>(POST /fraud/check)
 participant ATE as Authorisation<br/>Transactional<br/>ExecutorImpl
 participant AER as Authorisation<br/>EventRepository
 participant OES as OutboxEvent<br/>ServiceImpl
 Client ->> AC: POST<br/>/authorisations
 AC ->> AS: authorise(request,<br/>clientIpAddress)
 AS ->> AS: normalizeAndValidateCurrency()
 AS ->> Cache: get(AUTHORISE,<br/>accountId, idempotencyKey)
 alt Cache hit (fingerprint matches)
 Cache -->> AS: cached AuthorisationResponse
 AS -->> AC: replayed response<br/>(no DB/fraud call)
 else Cache miss
 AS ->> AR: findByAccountIdAndAuthoriseEventTypesAndIdempotencyKey(...)
 alt Existing row found (best-effort DB pre-check)
 AR -->> AS: AuthorisationEntity
 AS -->> AC: idempotent replay /<br/>IdempotencyConflictException
 else No existing row
 AS ->> AccR: findById(accountId)
 AccR -->> AS: AccountEntity

 alt account.status != ACTIVE
 Note over AS, FO: Account-active gate: skip fraud-service call entirely for a<br/>LOCKED/INACTIVE account (saves the call, and guarantees a locked<br/>account can never slip through just because fraud-service is down)
 AS ->> AS: PreAuthDecision.AccountNotActive(status)
 else account.status == ACTIVE
 AS ->> FO: evaluate(request,<br/>normalizedCurrency, clientIpAddress)
 FO ->> FS: POST /fraud/check<br/>(circuit breaker +<br/>250ms time limiter)
 alt fraud-service reachable
 FS -->> FO: decision APPROVE / DECLINE<br/>(+ riskScore, lockAccountRecommended)
 else timeout / circuit open / error
 FO ->> FO: apply fail-open policy<br/>(disabled by default)
 FO -->> FO: FraudDecision.unavailable -><br/>decline, or approve if<br/>trusted+tiny amount
 end
 FO -->> AS: PreAuthDecision.FraudEvaluated(fraudDecision)
 end

 AS ->> ATE: authoriseInTransaction(request,<br/>normalizedCurrency, preAuthDecision,<br/>correlationId)
 ATE ->> AR: findByAccountIdAndAuthoriseEventTypesAndIdempotencyKey(...)
 Note over ATE, AR: Authoritative idempotency check-and-insert guard against a<br/>concurrent request that raced past the best-effort check above

 alt Existing idempotent row found (race)
 AR -->> ATE: AuthorisationEntity
 ATE -->> AS: throw ConcurrentIdempotencyRaceException
 else New request
 alt PreAuthDecision.AccountNotActive
 ATE ->> ATE: build DECLINED (reason<br/>ACCOUNT_LOCKED / ACCOUNT_INACTIVE)
 else fraudDecision.isDeclined()
 ATE ->> ATE: build DECLINED<br/>(reason FRAUD_DECLINED)
 opt fraudDecision.lockAccountRecommended<br/>&& account ACTIVE
 ATE ->> AccR: accountEntity.setStatus(LOCKED)
 Note over ATE, AccR: Persisted atomically with the DECLINED event at commit
 end
 else fraud approved
 ATE ->> AccR: account.reserve(amount, currency)
 alt sufficient available balance
 ATE ->> AccR: flush() %% fail fast on DB constraints
 ATE ->> ATE: build AUTHORISED
 else insufficient funds
 Note over ATE: InsufficientFundException caught -<br/>account left untouched, authorisation still persisted
 ATE ->> ATE: build DECLINED<br/>(reason INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS)
 else concurrent account-version conflict<br/>(different idempotency key)
 ATE -->> AS: throw AccountConcurrencyConflictException
 end
 end

 ATE ->> AR: saveAndFlush(authorisation<br/>AUTHORISED/DECLINED)
 ATE ->> AER: saveAndFlush(event<br/>AUTHORISATION_AUTHORISED<br/>DECLINED)
 ATE ->> OES: enqueueAuthorisation(...,<br/>OperationType.AUTHORISE)
 OES ->> OES: build AUTHORISE<br/>payload map
 OES ->> OES: save outbox event<br/>(status NEW)
 ATE -->> AS: AuthorisationResponse
 end

 alt Concurrent idempotency insert race
 AS ->> AR: findByAccountIdAndAuthoriseEventTypesAndIdempotencyKey(...)
 alt Matching winner payload
 AR -->> AS: AuthorisationEntity
 AS -->> AC: recovered idempotent response
 else Mismatch or missing row
 AS -->> AC: IdempotencyConflictException /<br/>IllegalStateException
 end
 else Concurrent account-version conflict<br/>(different idempotency key)
 AS -->> AC: 409 Conflict (retry hint)
 else No race
 AS ->> Cache: store response (TTL)
 AS -->> AC: AuthorisationResponse
 end
 end
 end

 AC -->> Client: 200 OK<br/>/ error",
 "config": null
